title: SWF button export: DefineButton2 tag for Button symbols
description: Button symbols (symbolType='button') have 4 states in Flash 8: Up, Over, Down, Hit. Each state's shapes are stored in the symbol's timeline as keyframes at fixed indices (0=Up, 1=Over, 2=Down, 3=Hit). Export to SWF via DefineButton2 (tag 34): (1) ButtonRecords array — one record per shape in each state; each ButtonRecord: PlaceFlagStateHitTest/StateDown/StateOver/StateUp bits UI8, CharId UI16, Depth UI16, MATRIX, CXFORMWITHALPHA; (2) ButtonConditions array — one ButtonCondition per event (OnRollOver, OnRollOut, OnPress, OnRelease, etc.) with ActionScript bytecode; (3) DefineButton2 tag: ButtonId UI16, ReservedFlags UI8, TrackAsMenu bit, ActionOffset UI16, ButtonRecords, null-terminator, ButtonConditions. Also: DefineButtonSoundDef (tag 17) for button sound events if the button's frames have sound. Add encodeDefineButton2() to packages/swf/src/buttons.ts (new file). Wire into compile.ts pre-pass: for each Symbol with symbolType='button', emit DefineButton2 instead of a sprite/timeline. Add tests: packages/swf/src/__tests__/buttons.test.ts — verify tag 34, ButtonRecord state bits, correct CharId references. Only touches packages/swf/src/ — no authoring-ui changes.
